external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and receives a token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state what credentials colleagues use or whether they are asked for a second factor.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not state which franchise colleagues the identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague and group-membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated for franchise colleagues that vouches for their identities to the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not identify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates franchise identity-provider sign-ins, and supplies public signing-key material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The source does not state the broker's technology, exposure, interface kind, authentication mechanism, or whether colleagues are asked for a second factor. The broker pulls HR changes once a night; leavers stop being colleagues through that process. Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be withdrawn before expiry.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens for every application.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The source does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: sign-in

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: token carrying the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: token carrying the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: public half of the signing key

data_flows.name: vouch identity
data_flows.description: The identity broker obtains a sign-in assertion from the franchise identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.data_description: franchise colleague identity sign-in

data_flows.name: pull membership
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The changes include the overnight updates that make leavers stop being colleagues.
data_flows.data_description: colleagues and the groups they are in

data_flows.name: write directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes colleague and group-membership data into its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: colleagues and the groups they are in

data_flows.name: read directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads colleague and group-membership data from its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: colleagues and the groups they are in

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key from the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The same key signs the tokens for every application.
data_flows.data_description: signing key

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what the audit log records or whether it covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: sign-ins

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.
trust_boundaries.notes: The store admin console is also stated to run on this network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The home-device environment from which colleagues may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's colleague and group-membership contents are confidential because they identify or describe people.
assumptions.basis: The directory stores colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's sign-in records are confidential because they identify or describe people.
The key store's signing key is confidential because signing keys are secrets and credentials.
assumptions.basis: The key store holds the signing key used to sign tokens.
